title: Dental PPO Plans Pediatric Out-of-Pocket and Primary Payment Treatment on Reprocessed Grace-Period Lines
content:
**Rule.** The patient share on a Dental PPO Plans line reprocessed after a not-eligible denial made during a premium grace period (a reprocessed grace-period line) follows the person and the other coverage.
- For a person receiving the pediatric essential-health-benefit treatment on a line from an in-network practice, the patient share is first limited to the pediatric out-of-pocket room (the pediatric out-of-pocket maximum for one child less the person's pediatric out-of-pocket postings net of reversals for the benefit year) and then reduced by any primary payment recorded on the line. The plan payment on such a line is the allowance less that limited share, so the line that crosses the pediatric out-of-pocket maximum pays the allowance minus the cost sharing still remaining and a later line pays the full allowance.
- For any other line on which a primary payment above 0.00 is recorded, the patient share is reduced by that primary payment.
- Otherwise the patient share is not adjusted.
- The patient share is never below zero.

**Figures.** The pediatric treatment applies on an individual exchange enrollment to a date of service before the person's 19th birthday (19 on every plan). The one-child pediatric out-of-pocket maximum is 425.00 on Value 1000 and Plus 1500 and 0.00 on Preventive 750, Classic 1250, Premier 2000 and Elite 2500.

### Combinations (hypothetical share before this rule 52.40)
| Pediatric treatment | In-network practice | Primary payment | Net pediatric postings | Patient share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | none | 425.00 | 0.00 (no room left) |
| Yes | Yes | none | 391.15 | 33.85 |
| Yes | No | 20.00 | not counted | 32.40 |
| No | either | 60.00 | not counted | 0.00 (never below zero) |
| No | either | none | not counted | 52.40 |
